description: Create a site in a Replo project together with its git repository, forked from a published starter template ('blank' unless template is given). Pass projectId from list_projects and a name for the site. Returns the site with clone_url; clone it over Git with a repo key from create_api_key. Creating a site does not publish it.

name.description: Dashboard display name for the new site.

template.description: Published starter template to fork the site's repository from, e.g. 'notion'. Defaults to 'blank'.

name: create_site
title: Create site
